name: unified-change-plan-codex-switch
title: Codex Provider Change Plan Switch Vertical Slice
description: Implement the first baseline-bound Unified Change Plan vertical slice for switching an existing Codex Provider, with one approval, durable job state, local readback, partial/recovery truth, and a shared result dialog.
creator: codex
notes: Implemented and verified the existing Codex Provider switch vertical slice through immutable plan, atomic admission, one writer call, durable readback/reconciliation, thin IPC/query, and shared dialog. Fresh focused tests, cross-layer integration, mise run check, cumulative scope/redaction audits, and a current-host macOS debug app LaunchServices smoke passed. The app bundle is for local trial only; it is not signed/notarized production, Windows, real-agent-use, or user-acceptance evidence.
